fact: Law L/2025/020/CNT of 27 August 2025 requires the State to adapt information and communication technologies for persons with disabilities, with accessible public audiovisual information via subtitles or sign language (art. 70) and access to public information (art. 12, 37).
title: Loi portant promotion et protection des droits des personnes en situation de handicap (L/2025/020/CNT)
publisher: République de Guinée (texte publié par GuinéeLex)
